changes: Native fixed Darwin C declarations retain 64/128-bit short vectors and one-to-four-member HVA, including nested records and arrays, full FP-bank exhaustion, natural spills and all result words.
Larger complete non-HVA vector records retain original indirect argument and x8 result addresses. Anonymous C record names preserve vector and array identity.
Native LLVM, HighC O0/O2 and LLVMC O0/O2 share the validated physical call layout and original authenticated call instruction.
SDK/SP verifiers and the controlled model environment journal disposable products before producer launch and recover interruption without deleting formal inputs or active compiler output.

runtime_relocations.kind: External Mach-O ARM64_RELOC_BRANCH26 BL to undefined _memcpy, translated to ELF CALL26. Final linked bytes are verified exactly except the declared branch displacement to the tested freestanding memcpy.
runtime_relocations.raw_scope_correction: The raw summary retained the older unchanged-routes wording. Forty HighC O0 objects required the declared runtime relocation; the input objects themselves are unchanged and no IR was recompiled or retargeted.

llvm_fork.contract: MC rewrite resolver and fixup hooks retain key, discriminator, address diversity and final storage address. Authenticated storage requires a consuming installer. Mach-O/ELF, all keys, both address-diversity settings, local/external and alias/addend controls are covered.

retained: source projections, commands and failure logs

remaining: Automatic recovery of arbitrary source prototypes, vector variadics, packed/union layouts and other language ABIs are not qualified by these fixed C fixtures.
Authenticated whole-image storage/import installation and signed-unwind publication remain incomplete. The new fork MC interface is not dyld installation.
Native Apple PAC/CPA2 execution, signed exception unwinding, exact fault-PC/full ESR equality remain unqualified.
The exact invalid-PAC exception class of generic untyped C O0 calls is outside this fixed-prototype qualification.
The r6 backend still rejects legacy Apple llvm.ptrauth globals; r7 prebuilt delivery is separate.

remote_ci.reason: The GitHub diagnostics connector reports the selected connection changed or is unavailable.

post_fix_objects.meaning: All canonical objects remain byte-identical after the source type admission and grouping fix. The earlier model executions remain applicable; no second execution is claimed.

native_signed_unwind_environment.conclusion: Arm64 controls pass both backtrace and C++ cleanup at O0/O2. Compiled arm64e controls terminate with SIGKILL before reporting completion. This is an environment control, not NeverD signed-unwind qualification.
